assets.title: Slide 2 — Original contact predictions
assets.description: Original 30-epoch policies with blue predicted contacts and green nearest true-part points. One illustrative trial; the slide table summarizes 39 initial observations.
assets.instruction: Hold onto the left of the bottle.

assets.title: Slide 3 — Contact input strength
assets.description: Same trained checkpoint with three contact-input strengths. All three policies fail this bottle trial; approach behavior differs. The slide table reports all 39 trials.
assets.instruction: Hold onto the left of the bottle.

assets.title: Slide 4 — Normalized control versus contact
assets.description: Mug grasp: control succeeds and contact fails in this trial. This individual example illustrates the 4/39 versus 0/39 comparison. Expert is a task-matched demonstration from a different episode.

assets.title: Slide 4 — Stalled touch motion
assets.description: Mug touch, not grasp. Both policies remain near their starting pose. This does not establish gripper closure as the cause. Expert is a task-matched demonstration from a different episode.

assets.title: Slide 5 — Training-label timing
assets.description: All three panels show the same expert RGB. The labels compare current-action and next-action targets; these are not predicted-policy rollouts.

assets.title: Slide 6 — Same-index versus next-action pilot
assets.description: Same-index fails and next-action succeeds in this example. Both are contact-disabled MLP continuations; expert is a task-matched reference.

reference_note: Expert reference is leftmost in model comparisons. Task-matched references may have different source episodes and initial scenes. Playback follows nominal elapsed sample index, not task phase. Earlier finishes hold their final frame.

diagram_images.title: Slide 1 — Unified architecture
diagram_images.description: Simplified forward dataflow for the current two-frame unified MLP. The teal contact contribution is enabled for normalized unified contact and disabled for unified control and timing runs. The skill hierarchy, visual part grounding and contact prediction remain active.
diagram_images.conditioning_expression: features + P(0) + weight * LayerNorm(P((contact - TCP)/0.1) - P(0))
diagram_images.simplification: Shared encoders, hierarchy, and fusion are grouped rather than drawing all internal attention connections. Explicit contact geometry is detached from action-loss gradients. This is a forward architecture diagram, not a performance claim.
